correctness.rationale: Exact three-projector Laplacian spectral decomposition yields four entry formulas. Nonnegative denominators make off-diagonals positive. Scalar response global lower bound gives positivity for \(m\le10\); hub diagonal quadratic discriminant gives one negative interval exactly for \(m\ge11\); the leaf quartic has exactly two positive simple roots by Descartes rule, positivity through \(h=3\), negativity at \(h=8\), and positive leading term. Hub upper root is <2 whereas leaf lower root >3, establishing three distinct safe windows. Asymptotic expansions follow by exact polynomial substitutions. The verifier passed 3951 symbolic, rational full-matrix and root assertions. Claims do not extrapolate finite tests to all m.

value.rationale: For an archetypal heterogeneous-degree diffusion graph, the complete exact positivity set is a nontrivial three-component set, unlike conventional one-horizon SSP descriptions. Hub and leaf diagonals fail at sharply separated times; the middle safe interval converges to \([2,3]\), but final recovery grows linearly with network size. These are structural, motivated restrictions on timestep selection, not a mere routine computation or insignificant numerical gain.
